purpose: Retarget Diddy Monkey Flip motions onto G&W c07 by bone-name intersection, replacing the previous raw byte copies.
binding_semantics: Recipient animation node order is alphabetical, skeleton order is hierarchical, so transform binding is by node name, not index.

visibility_group.rationale: G&W c00 carries no Material nodes at all, and its Visibility node set and values are canonical (one value-vector across all 237 motions sharing the dominant node set), so the donor groups are dropped and the recipient group is used.

carriers.why: Each slot loads an animation name the base install already has, written over by this tool. Newly added animation names were observed not to load at all: the phase ran for the length of whatever clip was already on screen, and that length changed with what the player had been doing before the input. The carriers are Game & Watch animations for the side-B and down-B that this mod has already replaced, so no playable pose changes.
